collections.title: Sounds and tools
collections.blurb: Sample banks cleared for use, and tools that turn MIDI, humming or a song into Strudel code.

items.title: AuditeMarlow/samples
items.note: Drum samples by Audite Marlow (Niek den Breeje) — https://github.com/AuditeMarlow/samples — MIT – loads with soda: no samples() line needed.

items.title: fstiffo/polifonia-samples
items.note: Bell samples (San Pietro, Avegno) by Francesco Stiffoni / Polifonia Song Contest 2024 — https://github.com/fstiffo/polifonia-samples — CC0 1.0 – loads with soda: no samples() line needed.

items.title: hvillase/cavlp-25p
items.note: Object sounds by Hugo Villaseñor (hvillase), course cavlp-25p — https://github.com/hvillase/cavlp-25p — GPL-3.0 – loads with soda: no samples() line needed.

items.title: strudel samples
items.note: strudel-samples.alternet.site – search and preview samples from known Strudel sample packs and add your own.

items.title: Melograph
items.note: Hum or upload a melody, inspect its pitch contour and notes, edit, then open the generated Strudel code. GPL-3.0.

items.title: MIDI to Strudel
items.note: Converts MIDI files into Strudel note notation (Python script or an HTML page). GPL-3.0.

items.title: midi-strudel
items.note: Browser MIDI-to-Strudel converter: finds key, tempo, time signature and drum tracks, writes each track as absolute notes or scale degrees. No license stated.

items.title: Toaster
items.note: Listens to a song and writes it out as Strudel code as it plays – kick, hats, bass line, chords – then opens it in strudel.cc. MIT.

items.title: PLAYER
items.note: A local-first Strudel song builder: live code editor, step sequencer, piano roll, sound browser, timeline/arrangement, effect knobs, .strudel import/export. AGPL-3.0.

items.title: Strudel Neovim Controller
items.note: strudel.nvim – drive strudel.cc from Neovim: write patterns in your editor, play them in the browser. AGPL-3.0.

collections.title: Community originals
collections.blurb: Original Strudel pieces shared by their authors across techno, drum & bass, dub, ambient, glitch, world and game music. Licensed ones may be reused; the rest open here unchanged – ask the author before reusing.

items.title: Fail-safe
items.note: Original full set piece by DJ_Dave published as code; repo has no LICENSE file, the license is in the @license tag. NC: no commercial reuse.

items.title: from-scratch (session 2026-08-26)
items.note: 132 BPM 909 from-scratch performance archive; repo is a personal pattern archive meant for copy-paste reuse.

items.title: MOVEMENT (germantechno3)
items.note: Vanilla-Strudel German-techno track (no external samples); repo of mostly-techno originals plus a few covers.

items.title: house
items.note: Sketch in a folder of ~35 original ideas by a French live coder; uses Switch Angel's prebake and pad samples.

items.title: Squeaky Tinkering
items.license: CC BY-NC-NA (as written; not a real CC licence, probably meant CC BY-NC-ND or BY-NC-SA)
items.note: Short 909 groove from a university professor's song experiments. The licence tag is malformed, so ask the author before reusing it.

items.title: Ossuary
items.genre: UK bass: dark halftime drum & bass
items.note: 172 BPM halftime piece with a 32-bar arrangement; one of eight tagged liquid-DnB originals in the repo. Its chant sample is CC0 from Freesound, credited in the file.

items.title: Low Tide Radio
items.note: Liquid DnB original that loads Switch Angel's prebake script and pad samples.

items.title: Deep Meditation (DnB)
items.note: Ambient DnB; the companion file ambient_breaks-dnb.js is in the same repo.

items.title: footwork
items.note: Short 160 BPM footwork sketch from the gallery on ikesau.co/strudel, using Switch Angel's pad samples. The only human-made footwork piece found.

items.title: jungle-gym
items.note: Same gallery as the footwork sketch; shown with prose notes on ikesau.co/strudel.

items.title: beatopia dub 250721
items.note: 80 BPM dub piece on the LinnDrum bank. The only human-made dub original found.

items.title: ambient 251003
items.note: One of four dated ambient pieces in the repo (250129, 250721, 250725, 251003).

items.title: atmos
items.note: 80 BPM atmospheric sketch built on Switch Angel's pad samples.

items.title: ambient-experiment
items.note: Student patch from Concordia's CART398 'one patch a day' course. The header says it is 'based on' a YouTube video, so it is derivative rather than fully original.

items.title: Song Sanctuary theme
items.genre: world / hand percussion (shaker, clave, bongo) game score
items.note: Game score for Endless Access's open-source game Threadbare, written in Strudel. Licensing is very clean: SPDX header plus a README licence section.

items.title: Guarded Stones
items.note: Stealth-level cue built from clave, bongo, finger cymbal and clap; the rendered OGG stems sit alongside the code.

items.title: Saudade Nº0
items.note: Brazilian Portuguese author. The repo holds ~20 dated Strudel sketches from 2024 to 2026. Some are covers (e.g. 25/05-22 is a Mãeana song), so check each file.

items.title: glith (glitch)
items.note: 140 BPM supersaw/wavetable glitch sketch; glitch_with_friends.str is in the same folder.

items.title: glitchwave_one
items.note: Unfinished 140 BPM piece by a self-described live-code artist; Albanian-named pattern labels.

items.title: Corporate — Glitch
items.note: Adaptive game cue for the browser game Starnet; its layers are gated by a gameProgress signal. Other cues are in audio-content/songs/.

items.title: let code die v1.1 (pastagang album corpus)
items.note: Index of 36 strudel.cc share links from pastagang's nudel jams, plus a CSV dump of the code. Collective authorship: credit 'pastagang'.

items.title: Fio
items.note: Generative audiovisual sketch from the same series as Saudade Nº0.

items.title: lofi-1
items.note: 80 BPM lo-fi beat on chopped breaks125; the repo is a library of REPL sketches by an author who also publishes a sample-pack template.

items.title: hiphop strudel beat (jam element)
items.note: Default beat built into a web jam app: a minimal kick/snare boom-bap groove. Thin; it is better treated as a reference than as a piece.
